description.en: Fills the given array with the current playback frame/state of a loaded camera motion.
Handle of the camera to query.
Array that receives the camera's current frame data; passed by reference and filled in place.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Read the loaded camera's current playback frame
CMND_GET_CAMERA_FRAME(hCamera, cmr_frm);
